mechanism: Memantine (NMDA antagonist) combined with lisdexamfetamine (prodrug of amphetamine) may increase CNS stimulation and dopaminergic activity, with potential for additive effects on cardiovascular function and psychostimulant toxicity.
action: Use combination cautiously with close monitoring for excessive CNS stimulation, cardiovascular effects, and behavioral changes; dose adjustment may be needed and baseline cardiac assessment is recommended.
